sample_unit: webpages/sources (20 per platform across Google, Bing, Gemini, ChatGPT)

links.outcome: Readability (Flesch Reading Ease and Grade Level) of health information from search engines and AI chatbots
links.effect: No statistically significant readability differences between platforms; all content exceeded recommended reading levels for public health information.
links.quote: Readability analysis revealed no statistically significant differences between platforms; however, all content exceeded recommended reading levels for public health information.

screen.reason: Empirical comparison of the quality, credibility, and readability of health information generated by LLM chatbots versus traditional search engines for public consumer health queries.
